products.note: Finance-specific LLM; market data integration; proprietary data handling; trading decision risk

reading.body:
Bloomberg's primary AI entry in this dataset is a single finance-specific large language model, Bloomberg GPT, categorized under Finance & Legal AI, with noted integration into market data and explicit attention to proprietary data handling and trading decision risk.

The pattern here is vertical specialization: rather than a general-purpose model, Bloomberg GPT is built around the kind of structured, high-stakes financial data that Bloomberg has accumulated since its founding in 1981. The note on trading decision risk signals that the deployment context carries consequences that generic models are not designed to manage, which is a meaningful distinction for AI in regulated financial environments.

The data covers one product and a headquarters address. It does not cover model size, training compute, infrastructure footprint, power consumption, or any deployment scale figures. No connection to compute capacity or grid demand can be drawn from what is here.
